placeholder.agent: Search agents by name or code
placeholder.customer: Search customers by name, phone or e-mail
placeholder.company: Search companies by name or tax id
placeholder.factory: Search factories by name or code

terms.pctHint: Of net sales before VAT, after discounts
terms.capHint: Commission on an order never exceeds this share of its gross margin
terms.bountyHint: 0 if this plan pays no factory bounty

errors.firstOrderPct: Enter the first-order rate as a number from 0 to 99.99
errors.repeatOrderPct: Enter the repeat-order rate as a number from 0 to 99.99
errors.marginCapPct: Enter the margin cap as a number from 0 to 99.99
errors.minBaseAmount: Enter the minimum base as an amount
errors.factoryBountyAmount: Enter the factory bounty as an amount

list.title: Sales agents
list.description: Employees and freelancers who sell for us, the customers attributed to each, and the commission they are owed
list.emptyHint: Freelancers apply from their own account; add sales employees with the button above

createEmployee.title: Make a sales employee an agent
createEmployee.body: Employees use their own customer account to see their link and sales. Commission is paid through payroll, so no withholding tax is taken here.
createEmployee.customerHint: Have them sign up on the website first, then search by phone or e-mail
createEmployee.legalName: Full name as on the employee record
createEmployee.legalNameHint: Shown on statements and the payroll file
createEmployee.staffUserHint: Their back-office account, so the two are known to be the same person
createEmployee.needPlan: There is no active employee plan yet

applications.title: Agent applications
applications.description: Check identity, bank account and the agreement accepted before approving a freelance agent
applications.checksCount: {count, plural, one {# thing to check} other {# things to check}}

checks.tax_id_in_use: This tax id already belongs to another agent or vendor
checks.name_mismatch: The bank account name differs from the applicant's name
checks.has_orders: The applicant has ordered for themselves (their own orders earn no commission)

application.paymentNote: On approval this account is proposed to Finance, who approve it before any money is paid
application.agreement: Accepted the sales agent agreement version {version} on {date}
application.approveBody: {name} gets an agent code and link at once. A vendor is created (withholding tax under PND 1) and their bank account is proposed to Finance.
application.noteHint: Optional; included in the approval e-mail
application.needPlan: There is no active freelance plan yet
application.rejectBody: {name} gets an e-mail with the reason and can apply again

suspend.label: Suspend
suspend.title: Suspend agent
suspend.body: {name} ({code}) gets no new customers and no new commission while suspended. Linked customers stay linked.

reactivate.label: Reactivate
reactivate.title: Reactivate agent
reactivate.body: {name} ({code}) gets new customers and commission again

end.label: End agency
end.title: End agency
end.body: All of {name}'s linked customers, leads and referred factories end. Earned commission is still paid. This cannot be undone — type {code} to confirm.

agent.bankWarningBody: Statements can be approved, but payout runs will not pay until the account is approved

totals.pendingHint: Waiting for the claim window and full payment

agent.noTerms: This plan has no terms in force
agent.editBody: A plan change applies to orders placed from now on ({code})
agent.planHint: Changing the plan needs a reason
agent.needReason: Give a reason for the plan change

links.title: Customers linked to agents
links.description: Customers and companies who came through a link, a lead or a Sales assignment. Their completed orders earn commission while the link is active.
links.endBody: {name} will no longer be {agent}'s. Orders from now on earn no commission; commission already accrued stays.

assign.title: Link a customer to an agent
assign.body: For a customer the agent brought in without their link. A customer already linked to another agent cannot be linked again.
assign.subject: Link
assign.targetHint: Search by name, phone or tax id
assign.reasonHint: For example: the agent brought them to the showroom

leads.title: Agent leads
leads.description: Prospects agents registered — protected from other agents during the protection window, and converted when they sign up
leads.releaseBody: {name} will no longer be protected for {agent}; other agents can register them

factories.title: Factories referred by agents
factories.description: Factories agents brought into the network. The bounty is earned once the factory completes the plan's qualifying jobs.

linkFactory.title: Link a factory to an agent
linkFactory.body: For a factory that joined without the agent's lead. Qualifying days count from the link.
linkFactory.reasonHint: For example: the agent arranged the meeting with the owner

commissions.title: Commission
commissions.description: Every commission line: pending until the claim window passes and the order is paid, then earned, statemented and paid — and lines held because the agent shares an identity with the buyer
commissions.releaseBody: {agent}'s {amount} goes back to pending as usual
commissions.cancelBody: {agent}'s {amount} is cancelled and will not be paid

adjust.title: Adjust commission
adjust.body: Add or deduct commission by hand. It is earned at once and goes on the agent's next statement.
adjust.noteHint: The agent sees this on their statement
adjust.needAmount: Enter an amount other than zero

statements.title: Agent statements
statements.description: Each agent's commission for a month. Freelancers are paid by payout run with PND 1 withholding; employees go to payroll.
statements.emptyHint: A month's statements can be generated once that month has ended

generate.title: Generate monthly statements
generate.body: One statement per agent from the commission earned that month. A net of zero or less carries forward. The month must have ended.

payroll.title: Export payroll file
payroll.body: A CSV of the month's approved employee statements, for HR

approve.label: Approve
approve.title: Approve statement
approve.bodyFreelance: {agent}'s {no} for {amount} becomes a vendor bill (account 6160) with PND 1 withholding, paid in the next payout run. Type the number to confirm.
approve.bodyEmployee: {agent}'s {no} for {amount} is accrued (AG01) and ready for the payroll file. Type the number to confirm.

void.label: Void
void.title: Void statement
void.body: The lines on {no} go back to earned and onto the next statement

statement.awaitingPayoutBody: The vendor bill is booked; it is paid, with its 50 Tawi certificate, in the next payout run

plans.title: Commission plans
plans.description: What agents earn and on what terms. Every change is a new version someone else approves.
plans.pending: {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}} awaiting approval

createPlan.title: Create commission plan
createPlan.body: Its first version must be approved by someone else with plan approval rights before it can be used

plan.retireInUse: Move every agent off this plan before retiring it
plan.draftWaitingBody: A new version can be proposed once the waiting one is decided
plan.ownProposal: Your proposal — someone else approves it
plan.approveBody: Version {no} applies from {date} to the plan's {count} agents (orders placed earlier keep the earlier version)
plan.rejectBody: Version {no} will not apply; the proposer sees the reason
plan.proposeBody: A new version applies once approved and from its date — never backwards
plan.effectiveFromHint: If approved after this date, it applies from the approval
plan.retireBody: {name} can no longer be chosen for an agent; its approved versions stay in the history
